name: Mateo Vargas
bio:
Mateo's motorsport journey began unexpectedly during his mechanical engineering studies in Medellín. He volunteered at a local racing team as a data analyst, quickly realizing his talent for optimizing performance through meticulous data interpretation. After graduating, he honed his skills as a junior engineer for a Formula 3 team before transitioning to test driver coordination. 

At Proton by Premotion, Mateo is responsible for orchestrating rigorous testing schedules and analyzing feedback to improve car setup and performance. He believes in a data-driven approach, prioritizing detailed analysis and clear communication to ensure that test drivers and engineers are perfectly aligned. His relentless pursuit of perfection, combined with his mentoring approach to junior drivers, makes him a valuable asset.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a side part
physical.description: Mateo is of average height with a lean build.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with data and notes.
Drinks black coffee every two hours, precisely timed.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
